info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investor Relations Management API
info.description: The Investor Relations Management API allows businesses to update and manage investor-related information efficiently. This API enables users to modify the details of specific investor relations entities, enhancing communication and transparency with stakeholders. Typical consumers of this API include corporate finance teams, investor relations departments, and third-party financial services providers who need to maintain up-to-date investor communications. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their investor engagement and data management processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specific investor relations resource identified by RES-100045. Use this operation to modify relevant attributes and ensure that the investor information remains accurate and up-to-date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific details related to the investor relations of the corporate entity identified by RES-100045. It allows for partial updates to the resource, enabling modifications to only the needed fields while leaving other fields unchanged.
